claim: Since 2026-08-06 a new organization instance can be created with a Multi-Region option that automatically creates a customer managed KMS key and replicates the instance to an additional Region.
question: What does the one-click Multi-Region option do when you enable a new IAM Identity Center organization instance?

values.display: automatically creating a customer managed KMS key
values.spoken: it creates a customer managed KMS key for you

evidence.quote: | [One-click multi-Region instance creation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/enable-identity-center.html) | When enabling a new organization instance in supported Regions, you can choose between Single-Region, Multi-Region, or Custom instance configurations. The Multi-Region option enables multi-Region resilience in one click by automatically creating a customer managed KMS key and replicating your instance to an additional Region. | August 6, 2026 |

claim: Since 2026-08-04 you can choose whether to enable multi-account permissions when you create an organization instance; they are enabled by default and can be enabled later.
question: Must a new IAM Identity Center organization instance manage AWS account access?

values.display: By default, multi-account permissions are enabled

evidence.quote: | [Multi-account permissions are now optional for new instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/enable-identity-center.html) | When creating an organization instance, you can now choose whether to enable multi-account permissions.
